messages:
sara: quick sync — we saw a spike where org-level quota gets charged to the proxying service account instead of the originating project. unsure if this is routing or attribution semantics in the edge-router. anyone reproduced?

mihir: seen it once in staging. reproduction steps: send requests with X-Forwarded-Key: proj:123 and X-Proxied-By: sa:99, then the billing pipeline rewrites to sa:99 before quota lookup. looks like header canonicalization order.

tom: that matches my hunch — the router canonicalizes auth headers using the first valid credential it finds. currently order: bearer, x-api-key, x-forwarded-key. if proxy injects x-api-key last, attribution flips.

anya: console UX implication — teams will think their usage is zeroed out and support tickets will spike. can we add a telemetry tag so owners see "original_key" vs "effective_key" in the dashboard?

mihir: short-term patch: change router to prefer explicit X-Original-Key header when present. fallback: validate provenance with the proxying SA impersonation claim. config example: 

```
# router config snippet
auth.prefer_headers: ["x-original-key","x-forwarded-key","x-api-key"]
auth.provenance_check: true
```

tom: long-term we should standardize the attribution model: 1) billed entity 2) observed caller 3) proxy identity. expose all three in telemetry and let billing map via a policy.

anya: for rollout UX — propose a console toggle on project quota pages: "Show inferred attribution (experimental)". default off. we can enable for a few customers and surface diffs so support can triage.

sara: love the telemetry triad. @quota-bot can you create an alert when "effective_key != original_key" > 0.5% of requests for a project over 10m?

quota-bot: alert created: QUOTA_ATTR_MISMATCH_HIGH (threshold: 0.5%, window: 10m). linked to pager: eng-platform-oncall.

mihir: one more gotcha — cached KV entries (prefix caches) are keyed by effective_key today. that means if we switch attribution on the fly, cached hits will mischarge until the TTL expires. suggest adding cache key namespace including original_key when present.

tom: yep — change cache key to: cache_key = sha(namespace + ":" + effective_key + ":" + optional_original_key)

anya: documenting for support: short blurb + suggested dashboard widgets (percent mismatches, top proxies, impacted projects). i'll draft a one-pager.

sara: plan: 1) mihir to prod patch router header order (canary 10%) 2) tom to add telemetry triad and cache key change 3) anya to ship console toggle and support doc 4) quota-bot alert monitors rollout. target end of week for canary. any objections? :thumbsup:

mihir: :+1:

tom: +1

anya: +1, will start doc now

sara: ok launching canary. will post updates in this thread.
